title: Tool Over-Temperature
shortDescription: Motor or electronics exceeded safe limit.
fullDescription: Festool cordless tools display E01 on the LED bar when the brushless motor or driver hits thermal limit. Tool inhibits run until cool.

fixSteps.title: Vacuum vents
fixSteps.instruction: Use Festool extractor to clear cooling slots.

title: Battery Over-Temperature
fullDescription: E02 indicates the battery NTC reading is above limit. Pack will not discharge until cooled.

causes.cause: Heavy load on small Ah pack

fixSteps.title: Swap pack
fixSteps.instruction: Use second cool BP pack while first cools.

title: Over-Current / Stall
shortDescription: Motor protection cut power on stall.
fullDescription: E03 appears when the brushless controller detects current above allowed envelope, typical with bit jam.

title: Battery Communication Error
fullDescription: E04 means the AIRSTREAM data line between pack and tool is not communicating. Often dirty contacts.
symptoms: Tool will not run with charged pack

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Brass brush both pack and tool foot.

title: Battery Under-Voltage
fullDescription: E05 indicates pack voltage below the BMS cutoff. Charge before use.

faq.a: Long-stored packs may need TCL 6 wake.

title: Hall Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E06 indicates the EC-TEC motor's Hall sensors are returning invalid data, preventing commutation.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Send via Festool MyFestool service portal.

title: Trigger / Speed Dial Fault
shortDescription: Variable speed input invalid at startup.
fullDescription: E07 occurs when the trigger or speed-dial reading is out of range when battery is inserted.

fixSteps.title: Reinsert pack
fixSteps.instruction: Insert pack with trigger and dial untouched.

title: Controller Internal Fault
fullDescription: E08 reports an internal MCU fault, often clearable with a battery cycle.

title: Charger Pack Fault
fullDescription: Steady red LED on TCL 6 means the inserted BP pack failed self-test, often defective.

title: Charger Temperature Hold
fullDescription: Yellow blinking on TCL 6 indicates the charger is waiting for the pack to enter charge temperature window.

title: E1
fullDescription: Battery low voltage. Common indication on Festool cordless tools. Resolve by power-cycling, checking battery contacts, or contacting service.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean battery and tool contacts with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test on another tool
fixSteps.instruction: Try battery in another compatible tool to isolate.

whenToCallPro: If reset doesn't fix or BMS continues to trip, warranty service may be needed.

faq.a: Maybe — try another known-good battery first.
Most cordless platforms have 3-year battery warranty.
